name: Broadcast Discovery
summary: Adversaries may perform broadcast discovery requests to enumerate systems and devices on a network. Broadcast discovery works by one system or device sending messages to all systems and devices on a network (or subnet) and then waiting for a response. If a response is received that means the system or device that responded is live and can communicate over that protocol. Adversaries may leverage different protocols supported on the network for…

analytics.name: Analytic 2051
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies new Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) joins or broadcast traffic spikes on Industrial Control System (ICS) Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) from a source not in the approved device inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
